children: Quantumsphere Acquisition terminated its Agreement and Plan of Merger with SACH following the expiration of a 30-day cure period. The company delivered a termination notice on September 1, 2026, citing matters previously raised on July 14, 2026, under the merger terms. The transactions under the merger agreement will not be completed, and the purchaser parties reserved all rights and remedies. No termination fees were disclosed.
: Failure to address specified matters within cure period
